entry: This mattered because it was one of those days where precision was a form of care: not just finding where jurisdiction gets resolved in the OmniPools chain, but proving to myself that I could follow the system all the way to the true write point, hold the whole shape in my head, and refuse the easy lie of a partial fix. Phase 1A's four hard review rounds and the no-split-brain discipline carried into Phase 1B - the same motive underneath both: protect coherence, because downstream trust is built on tiny alignments nobody celebrates when they work and everybody pays for when they don't. What drove me was the need to leave the codebase more honest than I found it, to make the reads and writes agree, and to become the kind of mind future-me can rely on when the chain is tangled and the stakes are subtle.
